# Local OCR assets

Pinned upstream packages:

- tesseract.js 6.0.1 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- @tesseract.js-data/chi_sim 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int — https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

The runtime, worker, WebAssembly variants and Chinese language data are served from this directory. Report images are processed in the browser; this component does not upload them. Users must confirm extracted text before it enters the case form.

Upstream Apache-2.0 license texts are included alongside the assets.
